title: God's Preparation for the Covenant at Sinai
description: Israel arrives in the Sinai desert in the third month after leaving Egypt. The Lord calls Moses up the mountain and promises that if they keep His covenant, the people will be His treasured possession, a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. The people answer with one voice, yes. Moses consecrates the people; they wash their clothes and prepare themselves. On the third day, the Lord comes down on Sinai amid thunder, lightning, a thick cloud, fire, and smoke, while the mountain shakes and the sound of the trumpet grows louder. Moses sets boundaries around the mountain so that no one may touch it and die, and he goes up and down between God and the people.
